speaker: Doctor
text: That is an unusual presentation; have you noticed any muscle stiffness, tremors, or changes in your speech or writing lately? Also, have you been taking any new medications, especially for psychiatric conditions, in the past few months?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That improvement is excellent, but the movement disorder we discussed—such as stiffness or tremors—could be a side effect of the risperidone. Have you noticed any muscle stiffness, mask-like facial expressions, or difficulty swallowing since starting the medication?
